about: Exemptions of the parity matrix, each with its reason (scripts/parity_matrix.py). 'exempt': an operation without a dashboard path. 'via': the dashboard reaches the capability through other operations, 'note' says why. 'inputs': REST inputs the dashboard does not set. 'interfaces': inputs on REST or MCP only. 'answered_by_test': the browser test answers the request itself, and why. 'inputs' at the top level applies to every operation.

inputs.idempotency_key: A retry key for agents and scripts that may send a create again after a lost answer. The dashboard sends each create once: its form is locked until the answer arrives.

inputs.metadata: Add a job sends the address, role, company, place and pasted text; other details are added afterwards as keys and values in Correct the job (`jobs.update`).
inputs.raw: The provider payload of a collector; in the dashboard the owner pastes the posting text.
inputs.source_id: The collection source of a collected posting; a job added in the dashboard has none.
inputs.source_key: A collector's identity of a posting at its source; a job added in the dashboard is identified by its address.

inputs.availability: Deprecated since 0.21: whether the source still lists the posting is the No longer listed signal, shown on the job.

inputs.source_key: A collector's identity of a posting; Add a job looks the address up.

inputs.match_location: The selected job's Possible copies lists its group at the default matching; requiring the same place tunes the workspace-wide list for agents and scripts.

inputs.position: A new item goes to the end of its section; Move up and Move down place it (`policy.reorder`).

inputs.ready_since: The Ready to apply queue lists every Ready application by deadline; when an application became Ready serves agents and scripts that report a period.
inputs.ready_until: The Ready to apply queue lists every Ready application by deadline; when an application became Ready serves agents and scripts that report a period.

applications.staleness_list.note: Each row of Applications carries its changed inputs (`stale_inputs`, `stale_changes`) and the review page's Inputs tab reads the full report of one application; the workspace-wide list serves an agent that refreshes documents.

inputs.applied_until: Insights compares the last 90 days and all time (`applied_since`); a period that ends earlier serves agents and scripts.

inputs.q: Inputs lists the frozen copies of the open application; searching every copy serves agents and scripts.

inputs.template_id: The single-template form of `template_ids`, which the frozen-copy dialog sends.

inputs.claim_ids: The claims a revision cites are recorded by the agent that wrote it; the revision shows them. A revision the owner adds is its files.
inputs.knowledge_ids: The Career entries a revision cites are recorded by the agent that wrote it; the revision shows them. A revision the owner adds is its files.

inputs.q: A job's Files and the assets of Career and Templates list every file of their record; searching file names across the workspace serves agents and scripts.

inputs.subject_id: The Activity timeline filters by kind of record (`subject_types`), who, period and run; the changes of one record are its own timeline (`timeline.read`).
inputs.subject_type: The Activity timeline filters by several kinds of record at once (`subject_types`); the single kind serves agents and scripts.

inputs.started_since: Activity filters runs by status, and Today by activity since the last visit (`active_since`); the start time serves agents and scripts.
inputs.started_until: Activity filters runs by status, and Today by activity since the last visit (`active_since`); the start time serves agents and scripts.
inputs.token_id: Settings shows each token's open run beside it; listing one token's runs serves agents and scripts.

runs.start.exempt: A run belongs to the API token that opens it, and the token's writes are attributed to it. The dashboard session is the owner and has no runs; Activity shows every run, its report and its changes.

runs.update.exempt: Only the token whose run is open records its progress; Activity shows the notes in the run's report.

runs.finish.exempt: Only the token whose run it is closes it with its report; Activity shows the report.

inputs.changes_offset: A report names the first 100 changed records and links to the timeline filtered by the run, which pages through all of them.

inputs.answered_since: Today and Activity filter questions by state; what was answered since a time serves the agent's next run.
inputs.subject_id: Today and Activity filter questions by state; the questions of one record serve the agent.

questions.read.note: Activity and Today render each question from the list, which returns complete records; one question by id serves an agent following a link.

questions.ask.exempt: Questions are what the agent asks the owner. The owner answers or withdraws them on Today and in Activity, and writes to the agent with a request.

inputs.updated_since: Activity filters requests by state and Ask your agent by subject; changes since a time serve the agent's next run.

requests.read.note: Activity renders each request from the list, which returns complete records; one request by id serves an agent following a link.

requests.take.exempt: Requests are what the owner asks the agent. The agent takes, completes or declines them with its token; the owner writes and withdraws them in Activity and with Ask your agent, and sees their state and result there.

requests.complete.exempt: Requests are what the owner asks the agent. The agent completes them with its token and its result; Activity shows the result.

requests.decline.exempt: Requests are what the owner asks the agent. The agent declines them with its token and a reason; Activity shows the reason.

notes.list.note: The job and application timelines list every note with its scope, author, run and pin through the one timeline read; the notes alone serve agents.

applications.history.note: The application's Timeline lists its lifecycle events with its notes and its job's entries through the one timeline read.

inputs.until: Yield shows the last 30 or 90 days and all time (`since`); a period that ends earlier serves agents and scripts.

interfaces.inline: REST only: whether a browser shows the bytes or saves them is HTTP transport (Content-Disposition). MCP reserves a download address instead (`binary.transfers`).

password.update.answered_by_test: A real change signs out every browser session, the shared one of the browser tests too, so the test answers the request as the server does; test_archive.py changes the password over HTTP.
